description.zh:
旁路模式。取值范围：
- on：开启
- off：关闭
description.en:
The bypass mode. Valid values:
- on: enabled
- off: disabled

description.zh:
异常回源开关，开启后若函数出现异常如CPU使用超限则请求回源。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
The back-to-origin on exception switch. When enabled, if the function encounters an exception such as CPU usage exceeding the limit, the request is forwarded to the origin server. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

description.zh:
路由开关。取值范围：
- on：开启
- off：关闭
description.en:
The route switch. Valid values:
- on: enabled
- off: disabled

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.

description.zh: ER超时时间，取值范围5-60，单位秒（s）。
description.en: The Edge Routine timeout period. Valid values: 5 to 60. Unit: seconds.

title.zh: 修改边缘函数路由配置

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa update-routine-route --site-id 123456000000 --config-id 352816096980000 --route-name test_route --route-enable on --rule http.host_eq_video.example.com --routine-name test-routine1 --bypass on --sequence 1 --fallback on --timeout 5 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa UpdateRoutineRoute --region cn-hangzhou --RoutineName 'test-routine1' --SiteId 123456000000 --Bypass on --Timeout 5 --Fallback on --RouteName test_route --ConfigId 352816096980000 --RouteEnable on --Rule 'http.host_eq_video.example.com' --Sequence 1
